papers.title: Physicochemical evaluation, GC-MS-based phytoconstituent analysis and network pharmacology study of Guduchi Arka: an ayurvedic hydro-distillate.
papers.authors: Sharma D, Dane G, Tandon S, Jagtap C, Kumar V, Mondal S et al.
papers.abstract: Guduchi Arka is a classical Ayurvedic hydro-distillate formulation with quick absorption and healing properties, prepared from Tinospora cordifolia (Willd.) Miers. Despite its long history of traditional use, the scientific community still lacks a complete set of quality parameters for its chemical composition and its molecular mechanisms. To overcome this problem, laboratory analysis and computer modelling parameters were used to investigate the quality, safety, and effectiveness of the formulation in treating fever and cold. Guduchi samples were obtained from three locations in India (Jhansi, Bengaluru, and Itanagar), and the raw materials were analysed to verify compliance with API standards. Authenticated Guduchi samples were processed arka preparation by using a standardised hydro-distillation method, and the resulting arka was assessed by physicochemical analysis, with a pH of 6.15-6.95, a specific gravity near 1.00, and an essential oil content of approximately 0.236%. Raw drugs and Arka preparations complied with standard API safety standards, as no pathogenic organisms were detected, heavy metals, pesticides, and aflatoxins were undetectable, and microbial content was below the standard API limit. GC-MS analysis of the arka formulation revealed a consistent and rich array of bioactive compounds, including 1-Eicosanol, α-Campholenal, o-toluric acid, Anethole, Estragole, Embelin, Nicolaioidesin A, (-)-Globulol, Paliclavine, and Chamazulene. To assess its therapeutic significance, 20 phytoconstituents of the Guduchi arka formulation were screened using network pharmacology and molecular docking. These compounds showed 248 overlapping targets with genes associated with fever and respiratory infections. The key regulatory proteins HSP90AA1, EGFR, and HSP90AB1 emerged as central nodes in the protein-protein interaction networks. To better validate the molecular docking study, robust biological interactions were observed: Nicolaiodesin A interacted effectively with EGFR (score: - 7.2 kcal/mol), whereas Embelin interacted effectively with HSP90AA1 (score: - 6.6 kcal/mol). Finally, this study demonstrates that Guduchi Arka is a highly standardised and safe formulation that retains all its healing phytochemicals during the distillation process. This study elucidates the mode of action of Guduchi Arka on immunity and inflammation, providing a solid scientific basis for its traditional use and future applications in herbal medicine.

papers.title: Acupuncture-Related interventions for exercise-induced delayed-onset muscle soreness in active adults: A systematic review and meta-analysis for sport rehabilitation.
papers.journal: Journal of back and musculoskeletal rehabilitation
papers.authors: Liu R, Yusof HA, Zhong Z, Gao B, Hami R
papers.abstract: BackgroundDelayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS) is a common post-exercise condition that can impair athletic performance, training quality, and rehabilitation.ObjectiveTo evaluate the efficacy and safety of acupuncture-related interventions for exercise-induced DOMS in active adults.MethodsPubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and CNKI were searched from inception to December 2025, with a manual reference-list update in January 2026. Randomized controlled trials comparing acupuncture-related interventions with sham/placebo or no treatment in healthy adults with exercise-induced DOMS were eligible. Nine RCTs met the eligibility criteria, and seven contributed compatible pain data to meta-analysis. Two reviewers independently extracted data, assessed risk of bias using RoB 2, and rated evidence certainty with GRADE. Pain intensity on a 0-10 visual analogue scale was pooled using random-effects models.ResultsAcross seven RCTs, acupuncture-related interventions reduced DOMS pain at 24 h (MD -0.62, 95% CI -1.01 to -0.23), 48 h (MD -0.71, 95% CI -1.20 to -0.22), and 72 h (MD -0.84, 95% CI -1.35 to -0.32). Heterogeneity was low (I2 = 0%, 3%, and 23%, respectively). None of the pooled estimates reached commonly cited 1.0- or 1.3-point pain thresholds, and no DOMS-specific minimal clinically important difference has been established. Evidence certainty was moderate.ConclusionAcupuncture-related interventions may provide modest short-term reductions in DOMS pain, but their clinical importance remains uncertain. The evidence base is small and does not support dry-needling-specific conclusions. Larger, rigorously controlled, modality-specific RCTs are needed.

papers.title: [Clinicopathological and molecular genetic characteristics of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma with divergent neuroectodermal differentiation: an analysis of 17 cases].
papers.journal: Zhonghua bing li xue za zhi = Chinese journal of pathology
papers.authors: Zeng M, Li HL, Xu YY, Xie L, Mao RJ
papers.abstract: Objective: To investigate the clinicopathological and molecular genetic features of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma with heterologous neuroectodermal differentiation (ERMS-HND). Methods: A retrospective analysis was performed on 17 patients with ERMS-HND diagnosed from January 2021 to December 2025 at the Foshan Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Foshan, China. The clinicopathological, immunohistochemical, and molecular genetic characteristics were evaluated. Results: Among the 17 ERMS-HND patients, 15 were male and 2 were female. Their age was 24.0 (12.0, 46.5) months, ranging from 0.5 months to 22 years. Fourteen patients were children aged ≤5 years. The pelvic/genitourinary region was the most frequently involved site (8/17). All cases exhibited biphasic differentiation. The mesenchymal component was predominantly embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma (ERMS, 16/17). The neuroectodermal component encompassed the spectrum of neural crest differentiation, including neuroblastoma in 12 cases, ganglioneuroma/ganglion cells in 2 cases, composite ganglioneuroblastoma in 1 case, and Schwann cell differentiation in 2 cases. In addition to the classic configuration, two distinctive architectural patterns, namely micronest and inverted, were identified. The mesenchymal component uniformly expressed desmin, MyoD1, and Myogenin. The neuroblastoma component was mostly positive for synaptophysin (SYN), neuron-specific enolase (NSE), chromogranin A (CgA), and CD56, whereas the Schwann cell differentiation expressed only S-100 and/or SOX10. Only 2 cases showed focal PHOX2B positivity. RAS mutations were detected in 3 cases (HRAS mutation in 1 case and NRAS mutations in 2 cases). The tumor cells were all negative for FOXO1, PAX3 and PAX7. Case 17 showed no PRC2 alterations, NF1 inactivation, or CDKN2A/2B deletion, but retained H3K27me3 expression in Schwann cell areas, in contrast to the loss of H3K27me3 observed in malignant triton tumor. Conclusions: The neuroectodermal component of ERMS-HND encompasses the complete spectrum of neural crest-derived differentiation. S-100 and SOX10 are key and reliable markers for confirming the neuroectodermal component, while negativity of neuroendocrine markers such as SYN does not exclude this differentiation. Unlike malignant triton tumors, Schwann cell differentiation in this tumor does not exhibit loss of H3K27me3. Low PHOX2B expression in the neuroblastoma component may serve as an important marker for the differential diagnosis.

papers.title: Scalp acupuncture coupled with speech-language therapy modulates the ventral-dorsal structural brain network in patients with post-stroke anomia: a randomized clinical and DTI neuroimaging trial.
papers.authors: Song J, Nan R, Ni J, Chai L, Zhang L, Wang M et al.
papers.abstract:
Scalp acupuncture (SA) is used as adjunctive rehabilitation for post-stroke aphasia, but its effect on naming recovery and structural language-network changes remains unclear. We evaluated SA coupled with speech-language therapy (SLT) in patients with post-stroke anomia and explored diffusion tensor imaging markers of ventral-dorsal structural language networks.
This randomized controlled trial recruited 85 patients with post-stroke anomia and randomly assigned them to SA or control. Both groups received conventional stroke treatment and SLT; the SA group additionally received scalp acupuncture synchronously with SLT during needle retention. Treatment was delivered once daily, 5 days/week for 4 weeks. The primary outcome was WAB naming total score. Diffusion tensor imaging assessed white matter integrity and topological properties before and after treatment.
Compared to the control group, the SA group showed greater improvements in the WAB naming total score (P = 0.009), object naming, sentence completion, responsive speech, BNT spontaneous naming, and SAQOL-39 communication. In the ventral-dorsal structural network, the SA group showed smaller changes in the area under the curve (AUC) of small-worldness properties (P = 0.008) and normalized clustering coefficient (P = 0.017), and greater changes in clustering coefficient and local efficiency. In the SA group, the change in small-worldness was negatively correlated with the change in the WAB naming total score (r = -0.451, P = 0.027). The SA group also showed smaller axial diffusivity (AD) changes in the left uncinate fasciculus (P = 0.003, Bonferroni corrected), which correlated negatively with the WAB naming total score change (r = -0.440, P = 0.031). Exploratory adjusted regression showed that SA-group assignment was associated with greater naming improvement after adjustment for baseline naming and clinical covariates.
SA coupled with SLT was associated with greater naming recovery in patients with post-stroke anomia. The benefit was accompanied by changes in structural language-network topology and white matter integrity, particularly involving the left UF. These findings support further evaluation of scalp acupuncture as an adjunct to language rehabilitation and suggest structural network plasticity as a relevant imaging correlate.

papers.title: Large language models linking traditional Chinese medicine knowledge and clinical practice.
papers.authors: Li C, Zhang X, Zhu L, Zhu B, Chu C, Li X et al.
papers.abstract:
Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) is a complex medical system characterized by multi-source data, implicit knowledge representation, and syndrome-based diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning. With the increasing digitization of classical texts and clinical records, large language models (LLMs) have attracted growing interest as computational tools for organizing and utilizing knowledge related to TCM. However, existing studies remain scattered, and a comprehensive overview of data resources, modeling strategies, evaluation practices, and application scenarios is still lacking.
In this review, we summarize current research on the application of LLMs in TCM based on published literature. We focus on commonly used data sources, including classical texts, clinical records, and related structured resources, and review representative modeling approaches such as knowledge-enhanced and multimodal methods. Domain-specific training and fine-tuning strategies, as well as reported evaluation practices, are also summarized. Furthermore, we review representative application scenarios described in the literature, including medical consultation support, syndrome differentiation assistance, prescription-related support, education, and research assistance. Key limitations, such as limited interpretability, safety concerns, and the lack of standardized evaluation frameworks, are discussed.
By organizing existing studies along the workflow from data construction to model development, evaluation, and application, this review aims to clarify the current research landscape and highlight methodological challenges that should be addressed to support cautious and appropriate use of LLMs in TCM research and practice.

papers.title: Bufei Yishen formula ameliorates chronic obstructive pulmonary disease by restoring alveolar macrophage efferocytosis through Nrf2 activation.
papers.authors: Wei Y, Wu Y, Li C, Chen Y, Wu Y, Zhao P et al.
papers.abstract:
Bufei Yishen formula (BYF) is a traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) prescription clinically used to improve pulmonary function and quality of life in patients with stable chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, its mechanism in regulating alveolar macrophage dysfunction remains unclear.
This study aimed to determine whether BYF ameliorates COPD by restoring alveolar macrophage efferocytosis and to elucidate the involvement of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) signaling.
Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) was used to characterize macrophage alterations in COPD. Cigarette smoke/Klebsiella pneumoniae-induced COPD animals and cigarette smoke extract (CSE) alveolar macrophages were employed to assess the effects of BYF on lung injury, inflammation, efferocytosis, oxidative stress, and Nrf2 signaling. Nrf2 involvement was verified with dimethyl fumarate and ML385, and Nrf2-binding constituents of BYF were identified using Affinity ultrafiltration-LC/MS (AU-LC/MS), molecular docking, and surface plasmon resonance (SPR).
scRNA-seq analysis revealed that impaired macrophage efferocytosis is closely associated with COPD progression, identifying defective apoptotic cell clearance as a key pathological process. Consistently, in COPD animal models, BYF markedly improved pulmonary function, attenuated emphysematous and inflammatory lung lesions, reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine production, and corrected the imbalance between matrix metalloproteinases and their tissue inhibitor. To further clarify the underlying mechanism, RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) profiling of alveolar macrophages showed that BYF-regulated genes were mainly enriched in macrophage efferocytosis and Nrf2-related pathways. Mechanistically, both in vivo and in vitro experiments demonstrated that BYF activated Nrf2 signaling, promoted downstream HO-1 expression, reduced oxidative stress, and consequently restored cigarette smoke-impaired alveolar macrophage efferocytosis. Importantly, pharmacological inhibition of Nrf2 largely abolished the protective effects of BYF, whereas Nrf2 activation reproduced similar benefits, confirming the essential role of Nrf2 signaling in BYF-mediated macrophage protection. Furthermore, integrated AU-LC/MS, molecular docking, and SPR analyses identified nine constituents in BYF that interact with Nrf2, among which ononin exhibited the highest affinity (KD = 20.4 μM). Finally, ononin was verified to promote Nrf2 nuclear translocation, activate Nrf2 downstream genes, and may contribute to BYF-mediated efferocytosis restoration.
BYF alleviates COPD-related lung injury, at least in part, by activating Nrf2 signaling and restoring alveolar macrophage efferocytosis. These findings provide mechanistic evidence supporting BYF as a potential therapeutic strategy for COPD.

papers.title: Dendrobium huoshanense ameliorates spermatogenesis disorder in rats through modulating m6A methylation modification and the NRF2-GPX4/TLR4-MyD88 signaling pathways.
papers.authors: Tao R, Li X, Ji L, Li Y, Su T, Ma M et al.
papers.abstract:
Spermatogenesis disorder (SPD) has become a significant factor affecting male reproductive health. Dendrobium huoshanense (DH) is a rare and precious perennial orchid used in traditional Chinese medicine to nourish yin and tonify the kidney, but its mechanism in improving spermatogenic function remains unclear.
This study aims to elucidate the pharmacodynamic material basis and mechanism of action of DH in improving SPD.
Male rats were divided into blank control, model, positive drug, and DH high, medium, and low dose groups. SPD model was induced by Tripterygium wilfordii glycosides (TWG). Testicular histopathology, fibrosis, apoptosis, and protein levels of METTL3, METTL14, METTL16, WTAP, ALKBH5, TLR4, NRF2, and GPX4 were assessed. m6A-seq, metabolomics, and transcriptomics were performed to analyze m6A modifications and methyl donor abundance. Active components were identified via high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS).
DH aqueous extract attenuated spermatogenic cell loss, seminiferous tubules basement membrane fibrosis and germ cell apoptosis in SPD model group, up-regulated the protein expression levels of METTL3, METTL14, METTL16, WTAP, ALKBH5, NRF2, and GPX4 in testicular tissues of the model group, promoted consumption of carnitine derivative methyl donors, and increased m6A modification of Sox family (Sox4, Sox9, Sox11, Sox13, etc.), Nrf2, and Gpx4 in germ cells. The active components identified in DH aqueous extract primarily included bibenzyl and flavonoid compounds.
DH up-regulates the METTL3/METTL14 complex, promoting methyl donor consumption and enhancing m6A modification and protein expression of Sox9, Gpx4, and Nrf2, thereby alleviating oxidative stress and restoring impaired spermatogenesis.

papers.title: Natural (+)-camphor alleviates migraine induced by reserpine with local cerebral vasospasm via inhibiting p38β MAPK/ATF2 pathway.
papers.authors: Yang N, Qian Y, Gao Q, Shi G
papers.abstract:
The pathogenesis of migraine model by reserpine with local cerebral vasospasm matches the characteristics of migraine with cold-coagulation in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). Natural (+)-camphor (NC) is one of the Chinese herbal medicines with heat property, which is known to be effective in expelling cold and alleviating pain in TCM.
The proteomic analysis of migraine model by reserpine with local cerebral vasospasm and effect of NC was investigated to delineate the possible underlying mechanism.
Mice brain proteomic analysis was carried out by data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry. The biological information of differentially-expressed proteins was analyzed based on Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes analysis. Animal behavior, brain histopathology and NO generation assay were observed.
Compared with normal, migraine mice had lower pain threshold, severe brain lesion and reduced NO content in serum. NC could improve pathological change. A total of 479 differentially-expressed proteins were identified. 8significant differential proteins were focused based on analysis. The distinctive proteins are commonly related to MAPK signaling pathway, and p38β MAPK was validated, which was excessively expressed in migraine mice. NC could mitigate cold-coagulation migraine symptoms by regulating NO production via inhibiting p38β MAPK/ATF2 pathway.
NC showed analgesic effect, and p38β MAPK was most likely to be the targets against vasospastic cold-coagulation migraine.

papers.title: Metabolic and neuropathic outcomes following combined sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor therapy and adjunctive acupuncture in obese patients with diabetic neuropathy: a case series.
papers.authors: Kim YJ
papers.abstract:
Obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) are associated with chronic metabolic dysregulation and microvascular complications, including diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN). This case series describes metabolic and patient reported outcomes during ongoing empagliflozin therapy with adjunctive acupuncture treatment.
The prospective observational case series included three adult participants with obesity, T2DM, and symptom defined DPN. All participants received empagliflozin 10 mg daily for at least 4 weeks before enrollment and continued treatment while receiving standardized acupuncture twice weekly for 10 weeks. Primary outcomes included body weight, body mass index (BMI), and waist circumference. Secondary outcomes included neuropathic pain intensity assessed using the visual analogue scale (VAS), sleep quality measured by a single-item sleep quality score, and fatigue assessed using the fatigue severity scale were recorded at baseline and week 10.
All participants completed the intervention without adverse events. The body weight decreased by 4-9 kg, BMI by 1.2-3.5 kg/m2, and waist circumference by 5-10 cm. VAS reduction range from 2 to 4 points, sleep quality and fatigue scores also improved consistently in all cases. Exploratory outcomes indicated enhanced mobility, reduced nocturnal neuropathic symptoms, and high treatment tolerability.
Combined therapy with SGLT2 inhibitors and acupuncture was associated with improvements in metabolic, neuropathic, and functional outcomes in obese patients with T2DM, and DPN. These findings suggest that a potential multidimensional therapeutic approach, however, larger controlled studies are required to confirm efficacy.

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Physician-Generated Acupuncture Treatment Protocols Across Chinese and English Language Settings: Cross-Sectional Evaluation Study.
papers.authors: Liu X, Guo Z
papers.abstract:
Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) has received increasing attention in evidence-based medicine. However, its largely experience-based and practice-oriented nature has slowed modernization and standardization. Advances in AI provide new opportunities for integrating AI with TCM.
This study evaluates the application of large language models (LLMs), including ChatGPT (OpenAI) and DeepSeek, in generating acupuncture treatment protocols. We compare the validity and clinical effectiveness of physician-generated protocols with those produced by LLMs, examine differences in outputs across language corpora (Chinese and English), and establish a standardized assessment framework for systematically assessing the effectiveness of acupuncture point selection. Ultimately, this research aims to support the standardization of acupoint selection and promote greater consistency, reliability, and evidence-based development in acupuncture practice.
Qualified acupuncture treatment cases published in Acupuncture in Medicine were identified and translated from English into Chinese to create a bilingual case dataset. Standardized case prompts were independently input into DeepSeek and ChatGPT to generate acupuncture treatment protocols. Ten senior TCM physicians evaluated the AI-generated and physician-generated protocols using 7 criteria: local point selection, distal point selection, syndrome-based point selection, meridian-tracing point selection, neuroanatomical point selection, core acupoint selection, and synergistic effects. Repeated-measures ANOVA with sphericity assessment was used to examine differences across LLMs, language corpora, and protocol groups.
Blinded expert evaluations revealed significant differences among the 5 acupuncture groups for local point selection (P=.006), syndrome-based point selection (P=.005), neuroanatomical point selection (P<.001), and core acupoints coverage principle (P=.03). For local point selection, DeepSeek Chinese output received higher scores than the other evaluated outputs, while ChatGPT English output scored higher than ChatGPT Chinese output. For syndrome-based point selection, the journal physician-generated protocols received lower scores than the DeepSeek Chinese, DeepSeek English, and ChatGPT Chinese outputs. For neuroanatomical point selection, DeepSeek English output achieved the highest scores among the 5 groups. For core acupoints coverage, the journal physician-generated protocols received lower scores than the DeepSeek Chinese, DeepSeek English, and ChatGPT English outputs. No significant differences were observed among the 5 groups for distal point selection, meridian-tracing point selection, or therapeutic synergy. Overall, DeepSeek performed better in the Chinese-language setting, whereas ChatGPT performed better in the English-language setting.
AI has demonstrated substantial progress in encoding explicit acupuncture knowledge and performing systematic acupoint selection. However, challenges remain in individualized treatment and consistency across linguistic contexts. Enhancing bilingual or multilingual training corpora and developing syndrome-specific reasoning modules may improve the clinical applicability of AI-assisted TCM systems.

papers.title: Oral administration of ultrafine-grained Astragalus membranaceus enhances peripheral immunity in weaned black Xiangdong goats by upregulating the complement regulator C4bp and immunoglobulin responses.
papers.authors: Liao J, Sun J, Gebeyew K, Khan NA, Liu Y
papers.abstract: Astragalus membranaceus is a widely used immunomodulatory herb in traditional Chinese medicine; however, the effects of its ultrafine-grained powder (UGAM) on the peripheral immune system of young ruminants remain largely unexplored. Thirty-six weaned black Xiangdong goats (postnatal day 42; 5.34 ± 1.342 kg) were randomly allocated to a control group (n = 16; basal diet only) and a UGAM group (n = 20; control plus 10 g/d UGAM) from postnatal days 43-78, including 8 days adaption period. On postnatal day 78, blood samples were analyzed for complement proteins (C1q, C1r, C1s, C3, C4, C4bp, and Factor H), immunoglobulins (IgA, IgG, and IgM), and inflammatory cytokines (IL-1α, IL-1β, IL-6, IL-10, TNF-α, and IFN-γ), along with peripheral blood cell profiles. Hepatic complement gene expression was measured in a randomly selected subset of animals (Control n = 11; UGAM n = 16) using RT-qPCR. UGAM significantly increased serum C4bp concentrations and serum and hepatic C4bp mRNA expression (p < 0.001) and increased peripheral IgM concentrations (p = 0.032), whereas IgA, IgG, and all measured inflammatory cytokines (IL-1α, IL-1β, IL-6, IL-10, TNF-α, and IFN-γ) remained unchanged (p > 0.05). In the multi-parameter analysis, UGAM treatment was independently and positively associated with C4bp (partial r = 0.74, p < 0.001), and the overall correlation structure of the complement system was positively associated with that of the immunoglobulins (Mantel r = 0.36, p = 0.001). Oral administration of UGAM increased circulating C4bp and IgM and hepatic C4bp in weaned goats, consistent with engagement of homeostatic complement regulatary and possible post-weaning immune support. However, complement activity, plasma-cell responses, signaling, and safety were not measured; mechanisms remain hypothetical and require validation.
papers.title_ko: 초미세 아스트라갈루스 막반세우스 경구 투여가 이유 흑샹둥 염소의 말초 면역을 보체 조절인자 C4bp와 면역글로불린 반응 증가를 통해 강화한다

summary.question: 초미세 가공한 황기 분말의 경구 투여가 이유 흑샹둥 염소의 말초 면역 지표를 변화시키는지 평가했다.
summary.methods: 이유 흑샹둥 염소를 대조군과 UGAM 투여군으로 나누어 일정 기간 사료에 혼합 투여한 뒤 혈청 보체, 면역글로불린, 염증성 사이토카인과 간 보체 유전자 발현을 분석한 비교 연구이다.
summary.results: UGAM 투여는 C4bp의 혈청 농도와 mRNA 발현, 그리고 IgM을 유의하게 증가시켰고 다른 면역·염증 지표는 변화시키지 않았다.
summary.clinical_takeaway: 본 연구는 황기 초미세분말이 이유기 반추동물의 일부 체액성 면역 지표와 연관될 가능성을 시사하지만, 임상적 유효성과 안전성은 아직 확인되지 않았다.
summary.limitations: 보체 활성과 세포 수준 면역반응, 기전, 안전성을 직접 평가하지 않아 결과 해석에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Alleviation of senkyunolide A on hyperuricemia and hyperuricemia-induced renal damage in rats.
papers.authors: Wu JF, Liu YR, Weng JY, Zhou R, Li SM, Shi YH et al.
papers.abstract: Senkyunolide A (SEA), the major phthalide from the ethyl acetate extract of traditional Chinese medicine Chuanxiong (Ligusticum chuanxiong), potently inhibited xanthine oxidase (XOD) in vitro in our preliminary study. However, its efficacy in alleviating hyperuricemia and hyperuricemia-induced renal injury in vivo, along with its molecular mechanisms, remains unverified. The study found that SEA significantly lowered serum uric acid levels and attenuated hyperuricemia-induced renal damage of rats, while exhibiting no hepatotoxicity. Further mechanism study suggested that SEA inhibited the production of uric acid by inhibiting XOD. Moreover, SEA significantly promoted uric acid excretion. Western blotting results suggested that SEA increased protein expression of ABCG2 and decreased expression levels of GLUT9 and URAT1 in the kidneys. Transcriptomic, qRT-PCR and ELISA data revealed that SEA alleviated HUA-induced kidney inflammation of rats, which was associated with IL-17 and TNF signaling pathways. SEA significantly downregulated the mRNA expression levels of Nfkb1, Tnfrsf1a, IL-1β, IL-6, Jun, Cxcl1, Fos and S100a9. Simultaneously, SEA reduced the mRNA expression levels and inhibited the activities of caspase-3, caspase-8, and caspase-9 in the kidneys of HUA rats, indicating that SEA alleviated HUA-induced renal apoptosis. Overall, SEA exhibited excellent potential as a treatment for hyperuricemia with a favorable safety profile. This study firstly reports SEA as a candidate drug for hyperuricemia.
papers.title_ko: 센큐놀리드 A의 고요산혈증 및 고요산혈증 유발 신장 손상 완화 효과

summary.question: 센큐놀리드 A가 랫드에서 고요산혈증과 이에 따른 신장 손상을 완화하는지 평가했다.
summary.methods: 고요산혈증 랫드 모델에서 센큐놀리드 A의 생체 내 효과와 XOD 억제, 요산 배설, 염증 및 세포사멸 관련 기전을 분석했다.
summary.results: 센큐놀리드 A는 혈청 요산을 낮추고 신장 손상을 완화했으며, XOD 억제와 ABCG2 증가, GLUT9·URAT1 감소 및 염증·세포사멸 억제와 연관되었고 간독성은 보이지 않았다.
summary.clinical_takeaway: 본초 유래 성분이 고요산혈증과 신장 손상에 유망한 후보임을 시사하지만, 현재 근거는 랫드 전임상 결과로 임상 적용에는 추가 검증이 필요하다.
summary.limitations: 랫드 전임상 연구로 사람에서의 유효성과 안전성은 확인되지 않았다.
